pick.headline: Camp David Accords signed
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of September 18, 1978, carried, in largely illegible OCR, remarks at the Camp David signing ceremony and a Cairo MENA report that Sadat and Begin, with Carter as witness, had signed a framework for Middle East peace and one for an Egypt-Israel treaty.
